subject: Auth & SDK integration: keying strategy, rotation timeline, and routing
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara@bluepeak.com>, BluePeak Ops <ops@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Auth & SDK integration: keying strategy, rotation timeline, and routing

Hi Sara / BluePeak team —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick written recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can keep devs moving this week. High level items we discussed: SDK onboarding, auth model options, routing for staging vs. prod, and an initial plan for embeddings/reranker evaluation.

Recap / recommendations (short):
- Auth model: two pragmatic options for the pilot:
  1) Short-lived API keys + server-side HMAC signing: lowest lift for your backend (we issue scoped tokens that expire after N hours; rotation handled by your key manager).
  2) Service-account JWT (recommended for long-term): exchange JWT for short-lived tokens via our OAuth/JWT flow; integrates with KMS/HSM, supports granular scopes and audit logs.
- Key rotation: we propose automatic 30-day rotation for pilot keys, with the option to move to 7-day for sensitive workloads. See attached rotation-schedule.xlsx for a suggested cadence and rollback window.
- SDK setup: start with the Node/Go quickstart in the attached archive (redwood-sdk-quickstart.zip). We'll provide a small sample that demonstrates: initializing client with ephemeral token, structured output + tool-calling demo, and embeddings + reranker pipeline.
- Routing: request tagging (X-Redwood-Env: staging|prod) + model pinning will let you route traffic to cheaper quantized variants for background jobs and keep low-latency variants for live endpoints. We can pre-configure two route policies in the account.
- Embeddings / rerankers: suggest doing an initial 1k-query eval to pick embedding size and reranker threshold. We can run inference-based A/B on identical prompts using our SDK to measure latency/cost.

Open questions from your side we noted: SOC2 artifact access, KMS integration details, and procurement requirements for contract terms.

Proposed immediate next steps (please confirm):
1) BluePeak to confirm preferred auth option (API keys short-lived vs. service-account JWT) — please confirm by EOD tomorrow.
2) We (Redwood) share: SDK zip + rotation-schedule.xlsx + 30-min pairing session slot (suggest Wed 11/10 10:00am PT).
3) BluePeak to share: security contact and preferred KMS vendor (if choosing JWT/JWKS flow).

Attachments: redwood-sdk-quickstart.zip (sample code + README), rotation-schedule.xlsx (suggested cadence), mvp-integration-checklist.md (integration checklist for devs).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to unblock any of these.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0123
From: Sara Liu <sara@bluepeak.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, BluePeak Ops <ops@bluepeak.com>
Cc: BluePeak Procurement <procurement@bluepeak.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Auth & SDK integration: keying strategy, rotation timeline, and routing

Thanks Stephanie — super helpful summary. A few follow-ups from our security and procurement teams: 

1) For the pilot we lean toward the short-lived API key option for quicker integration, but we need clarity on token lifetime and rotation mechanics. Can your tokens be issued with a 4-hour TTL and support immediate revocation via API?

2) KMS: we plan to use Azure Key Vault for key storage. For the JWT path, does Redwood support JWKS discovery and rotation hooks, or would we need to proxy a key endpoint?

3) SOC2: procurement asked for the most recent Type II report or a point-in-time SOC2 summary. Is that available or do we need an NDA?

4) Can your SDK demo include a short example for embeddings + reranker flow (we want to see how to batch 50 documents and run similarity ranks)?

5) Pricing: procurement also wants a brief note on whether embedded/rerank usage is priced differently or counts as standard token usage. We can take the details offline with procurement but a one-paragraph note would be helpful.

If the pilot can start with 4-hour TTL tokens and immediate revocation, we should be able to run a staged rollout next week.

Thanks — we can confirm the auth choice by EOD tomorrow after procurement and security sync.

Best,
Sara
Sara Liu
Head of Integrations
BluePeak Financial
sara@bluepeak.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Re: Auth & SDK integration: keying strategy, rotation timeline, and routing

Stephanie / Laura — drafting responses to Sara's procurement/security questions below so we can provide a concise reply and the requested artifacts.

On Mon, Nov 8, 2027 at 4:30 PM Sara Liu <sara@bluepeak.com> wrote:
> 1) For the pilot we lean toward the short-lived API key option for quicker integration... can tokens be issued with a 4-hour TTL and support immediate revocation via API?
>
> 2) KMS: we plan to use Azure Key Vault for key storage. For the JWT path, does Redwood support JWKS discovery and rotation hooks?
>
> 3) SOC2: procurement asked for the most recent Type II report...
>
> 4) SDK demo for embeddings + reranker batching example?
>
> 5) Pricing question for embeddings/rerank (token count vs separate metric)?

Draft answers: 
- TTL & revocation: Yes — hosted API supports configurable TTLs down to 1 hour. We can issue scoped ephemeral keys with a default of 4 hours for your pilot. Immediate revocation is supported via our key revoke endpoint (POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/revoke); we'll provide a minimal server-side sample in the SDK zip.
- Azure KV / JWKS: For service-account JWT flow, we support JWKS discovery. We also provide a rotation webhook so your KMS can notify us when a key rotates; alternatively, you can push the new JWKS to our admin endpoint. We'll document both patterns.
- SOC2: we can share a redacted Type II summary immediately after an NDA; procurement usually accepts our PID/NDA route. If they need full report we can route through legal.
- SDK demo: include a Node example that batches 50 docs into embeddings and runs a re-ranker. We'll add that to redwood-sdk-quickstart.zip and mark it as "embeddings-batching.js".
- Pricing: embeddings are priced per embedding unit (size-dependent) and re-ranker calls count as standard generation tokens; I'll send a one-paragraph pricing summary for procurement.

Action items for us (internal):
- Laura: attach the redacted SOC2 summary and the one-paragraph pricing note.
- Stephanie: send updated SDK zip with embeddings batching example + rotation-schedule.xlsx.
- Ben: schedule the 30-min pairing slot for Wed 11/10 10:00am PT and add calendar invite.

I'll wait for Laura's artifacts then send a single reply to BluePeak.

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara@bluepeak.com>, BluePeak Ops <ops@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Auth & SDK integration: keying strategy, rotation timeline, and routing

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the questions. Quick answers and attached artifacts (redacted SOC2 summary + rotation-schedule.xlsx + updated SDK zip with embeddings-batching example):

- TTL & revocation: We can provision ephemeral API keys with 4-hour TTL and immediate revocation via API. Sample call: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/{key_id}/revoke. We'll include the sample in the quickstart.

- Azure Key Vault / JWKS: Supported. For the JWT/service-account pattern we support the following flows:
  • JWKS discovery (standard .well-known/jwks.json) — your Azure-managed JWKS can be pointed to our admin console.
  • Rotation webhook — when keys rotate in Azure you can POST the new JWKS to our rotation webhook URL.

- SOC2: attached is a redacted Type II summary that covers the controls most relevant to integrations. If procurement requires the full report we can proceed with an NDA route.

- Embeddings + reranker demo: included in the SDK zip as embeddings-batching.js (Node). It shows batching 50 docs into embeddings, storing vector ids, and calling the re-ranker call with a top-k pipeline. It also demonstrates structured output for the reranker score block so you can parse thresholded results.

- Pricing note: embeddings billed per embedding vector (size-dependent) and reranker calls count as generation tokens. Laura has attached a one-paragraph pricing blurb for procurement.

Suggested next steps and timeline: 
1) BluePeak confirms trial token TTL = 4 hours and security contact (we aim to provision pilot creds Wed 11/10 morning).
2) Pairing session Wed 11/10 10:00am PT — Ben will send a calendar invite.
3) BluePeak to provide procurement contact if you want pricing packaged for PO.

If that works I will provision a staging key set ahead of the pairing session so your devs can run the embedding + reranker sample during the call.

Best,
Stephanie
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
